subject: chemistry
title: Project work
textbookText: 1. Make a list of allotropes of sulphur in a chart paper and write the use of each. 2. Take a chart paper and draw Kipp's apparatus labelling its various parts and write the

working principle of it for the preparation of hydrogen sulphide gas. 3. Make a chart paper presentation showing comparison of bleaching action of Cl2 and SO2. 4. Take a chart paper and write the acidic, oxidizing and dehydrating properties of sulphuric acid.
1. Which of the following is used in photography?
2. What happens to the later compound, when SO2 gas is passed through potassium
3. Which of the following behaves as both oxidant and reductant?
4. Which of the following is true for sulphurdioxide gas?
5. What happens when dilute H2SO4 is treated with zinc metal?
6. What is the oxidation state of S in H2SO4?
7. In the reaction, BaCl2 + dil. H2SO4 → BaSO4↓ + 2HCl, what is the role of the acid?
8. Which of the following statements is wrong for SO2?
b. Its bleaching action is reversible
d. It is a mild bleaching agent
9. Which of the following turns lead acetate paper black?
